interpretation: Scheme behaves as designed (first order in time, ~second order in space) but the reference grid/dt carry substantial numerical diffusion (K_eff about 1.6K). Synthetic verification only.
limitations: Fourier test uses uniform wind along x; open boundary analytic comparison is 1-D strip only; no real-data validation
what_failed: Nothing failed. Initial claim of +31% numerical diffusion was incomplete (reviewer: total +61% at dt=60 s, 50 grid)
what_happened: Verification script ran (RUN-0001, 1m42s): Fourier spatial error 0.155/0.061/0.024 at nx=20/40/80 (ratio ~2.55), time error halves differences with dt, dt-refinement RMSE change 1.76e-4 -> 9.2e-5 (first order), grid 50 vs 100 differs by 0.40% of max, budget residual <=1.9e-14 relative, quadrature ratios 1+9e-8 at worst
what_worked: Discrete symbol agreement ~1e-14 (unit tests); mass budget closes; no negative values; K_eff matches (Pe/2)coth(Pe/2)-1+u^2dt/2K within 3%

interpretation: In this idealised matched experiment (same solver and grid for truth and inference: inverse crime) the amplitudes are well identified. This says nothing about real data.
limitations: Single noise draw and single layout; matched model; Gaussian noise with known sigma; accurate fields do not by themselves establish attribution
next_experiment: Deployment comparison across layouts and cases
what_happened: Reference simulate (RUN-0002, 2.8 s solve; max budget residual 1.6e-14, 0 negatives) and inverse (RUN-0003, 2m21s incl. direct route). 5 sensors every 600 s, S5 held out, noise 0.005 ug/m3 (~3% of 0.161 peak). q_hat=[97531,146718,78807] vs true [1e5,1.5e5,8e4]: relative L2 error 2.2%; regional RMSE 9.7e-4 ug/m3; held-out sensor RMSE 4.3e-4; rank 3, effective rank 3, condition 5.6; direct (least_squares) and cached (lsq_linear) agree to 4e-9 relative
what_worked: Both routes agree; weighted residual 8.2 for 96 observations (expected ~9.6 if model and noise are right)

interpretation: Within this synthetic matched setting, designing for the regional error with design scenarios helps; the main driver is avoiding plume-blind layouts (identifiability), so much of the gap vs spread/random is about covering the plume corridor rather than fine optimisation. Greedy is not globally optimal (tiny-fixture exhaustive gap up to 3.7x was seen in tests) and does not win every case.
limitations: 6+6 scenarios, 3 noise reps: modest; sd is not a confidence interval; matched model shares solver/grid with truth (see mismatch); single wind-ensemble definition; alpha choice not tuned
what_failed: alpha=0 headline means are dominated by a few unidentifiable draws; weak prior alpha=1 was adopted AFTER seeing this, chosen a priori (not tuned) and the alpha=0 run is kept as sensitivity. greedy_weighted is not reliably better than greedy even on the population metric (budget 2 worse).
what_happened: RUN-0004 smoke (18 s); RUN-0005 benchmark alpha=1 (4m56s, peak mem ~176 MB; 6 design + 6 test scenarios, 3 noise reps, 20 random layouts/budget); RUN-0006 same with alpha=0 (4m46s). Alpha=1 uniform-weight mean test RMSE (ug/m3), budgets 1/2/3/5/8: greedy 0.019/0.0037/0.00089/0.00039/0.00036; spread 0.022/0.015/0.0086/0.0086/0.0018; random(mean of layouts) 0.035/0.024/0.018/0.0076/0.0037. Paired greedy-minus-spread mean diff -0.0035/-0.0116/-0.0077/-0.0082/-0.0014, greedy better in 78/100/83/94/94% of 18 pairs. Alpha=0: unregularised fits blow up for layouts blind to the plumes (random 1-sensor mean RMSE 2e19, spread 4.8); medians sane. Greedy at alpha=0 is stable (0.019/0.0057/0.0012/0.00047/0.00026).
what_worked: Greedy selected on design scenarios beat spread and random on the independent test scenarios on average at every budget; design-to-test gap small for greedy

interpretation: Hidden wind error and an unmodelled source dominate over discretisation mismatch in this setup; refined truth shows the matched benchmark was only mildly optimistic from the inverse-crime effect (~+0.0006 ug/m3 at budgets >=3). More sensors do not fix wind or missing-source error: the floor is set by the model error.
limitations: One magnitude per mismatch kind (+20% speed, 15 deg rotation, one extra source of 60000 ug/s at one location); weighted layouts not evaluated under mismatch; 6 scenarios x 3 reps; synthetic only
what_failed: Not every individual draw worsens under mismatch (frac_worse 0.78-1.0 for refined truth and 0.83 in some budgets), reported as observed.
what_happened: RUN-0007 (7m51s). Fixed design-stage layouts from results/benchmark on the regenerated 6 test scenarios x 3 noise reps. Greedy mean test RMSE (ug/m3) matched vs refined-truth vs wind-perturbed vs extra-source at budget 3: 0.0009 / 0.0015 / 0.018 / 0.011; at budget 8: 0.00036 / 0.0010 / 0.016 / 0.010. Paired mismatch-minus-matched (greedy): refined truth +0.0005 to +0.0007 (worse in 78-100% of pairs); wind +0.012 to +0.017 (worse in 100%); extra source +0.008 to +0.010 (worse in 83-100%), unmodelled-source attribution error 15-50%. Poor corner layout (3 sensors): effective rank 0 in every case, condition inf or >1e8, singular values ~1e-9 or smaller; estimates collapse to the prior (source relative error ~1.0) while regional RMSE 0.03-0.08.
what_worked: All four conditions + poor layout executed from the saved design-stage layouts; diagnostics flag the poor layout

interpretation: The earlier alpha=1 (chosen after looking at test results) was close to but not equal to the validation-selected value. Selected alpha=0.1 is used for all final runs.
limitations: Criterion uses only alpha-independent layouts (random+spread), so it is not tuned for greedy layouts; validation is 6 scenarios; q_scale=1e5 ug/s is a numerical scaling matching the demo emission order, only alpha/q_scale^2 matters
next_experiment: Final benchmark on fresh test seeds 33/7000
what_happened: RUN-0008 (1m21s): 6 validation scenarios (seed 44, noise 9000) x 3 noise reps x (20 random layouts + spread) x 5 budgets = 1890 rows per alpha. Mean regional RMSE (ug/m3) by alpha: 0 -> 1.7e18 (413 rows >10x no-emission RMSE); 1e-4 -> 0.0709; 1e-3 -> 0.0302; 1e-2 -> 0.0175; 0.1 -> 0.0143 (selected); 1 -> 0.0146; 10 -> 0.0162; 100 -> 0.0191; 1000 -> 0.0247. Frozen to results/alpha-selection/alpha_selected.json before any run on test seed 33.
what_worked: Interior minimum on a 9-point grid spanning 9 decades; criterion curve is flat between 0.1 and 1 (2% apart) so the exact value is not important; prior mean is zero (prior_mean_uses_truth false); selection unit-tested to be independent of test seeds

interpretation: In this matched synthetic setting a design-optimised layout helps on average, mostly from 3 sensors up where it avoids plume-blind sites; the small-budget advantage is not established with 6+6 scenarios. This replaces EXP-003 as the deployment evidence; EXP-003's alpha=1 was chosen after seeing its test results.
limitations: 6 design + 6 test scenarios, 3 noise draws, sd is not a CI, matched model, single noise level, validation criterion used only alpha-independent layouts, greedy not optimal
next_experiment: Mismatch on the fixed benchmark-final layouts
what_failed: At b=1 and 2 the greedy-vs-spread advantage is small relative to the case-to-case sd (61-78% wins); greedy is 2.5x worse on test than on design at b=2 (selection optimism / design-case specificity); greedy_weighted is indistinguishable from greedy
what_happened: RUN-0009 benchmark-final (2m35s) and RUN-0010 alpha=0 sensitivity (2m36s) on FRESH test scenarios (seed 33, noise 7000) with alpha=0.1 read from results/alpha-selection/alpha_selected.json (sha256 cd526c9d...). Uniform-weight mean test RMSE (ug/m3), budgets 1/2/3/5/8: greedy 0.021/0.017/0.0015/0.00045/0.00041; spread 0.022/0.020/0.014/0.014/0.0013; random(mean over 20 layouts) 0.034/0.024/0.020/0.0093/0.0047. Paired greedy-minus-spread mean diff -0.0020/-0.0031/-0.0129/-0.0139/-0.0009 (sd 0.0105/0.0107/0.0134/0.0124/0.0015), greedy better in 78/61/78/100/78% of 18 pairs. Greedy design RMSE 0.012/0.0067/0.0013/0.00042/0.00029, i.e. test is 1.8x/2.5x/1.2x/1.1x/1.4x design. alpha=0 sensitivity: greedy means blow up at b=1,2 (0.44, 0.34) and random reaches 1e21; medians sane (greedy 0.024/0.0015/0.00091/0.00056/0.00033).

interpretation: Same ordering as EXP-004: hidden wind error and an unmodelled source dominate discretisation mismatch; more sensors do not remove the floor (b=5 vs 8 identical to two digits). The refined-truth effect is a lower bound because truth uses the same scheme.
limitations: One magnitude per mismatch kind; 6 test scenarios x 3 reps; weighted layouts scored uniform only; poor layout is only conditionally poor
what_failed: The poor layout is not uniformly poor under the new wind ensemble: it is well constrained in half the rows. Its sites were fixed beforehand and NOT changed after seeing these results (that would reuse test data); the diagnostics are reported per case
what_happened: RUN-0011 (3m10s). Fixed benchmark-final layouts on the fresh test scenarios (seed 33), alpha 0.1. Greedy mean RMSE (ug/m3) at b=3/5/8: matched 0.0015/0.00045/0.00041; refined truth 0.0033/0.0010/0.0010; wind perturbed 0.026/0.017/0.017; extra source 0.046/0.010/0.010. Paired mismatch-minus-matched (greedy): refined truth +0.0018/+0.0006/+0.0006 (worse in 94-100% of pairs at b>=3, but -0.0001 at b=1 with 78% worse); wind +0.025/+0.016/+0.016 (100% worse at b>=3); extra source +0.044/+0.010/+0.010 (100% worse). Poor corner layout: effective rank 0 in 18 of 54 rows, 2 in 9, 3 in 27 (the fixed corner sites are informative in some of the six random winds); regional RMSE mean 0.021, max 0.060.
